name: Comedy Teams
description: Two (or three, or four) heads are funnier than one: Laurel & Hardy's talkie shorts and The Flying Deuces, the Marx Brothers from The Cocoanuts to Duck Soup, the Three Stooges in Disorder in the Court and Brideless Groom, Abbott & Costello in Africa Screams and Jack and the Beanstalk, Martin & Lewis and Abbott & Costello hosting the Colgate Comedy Hour, plus Wheeler & Woolsey, Olsen & Johnson and the Ritz Brothers. The Abbott and Costello Show airs weeknights at 7:00 pm.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 73 hours of hand-listed team comedies 1929-1959: 39 Laurel & Hardy talkie shorts (1929-35) and two features, the first seven Columbia Stooges shorts plus the public-domain ones, Marx Brothers features, ten Wheeler & Woolsey films, and Colgate Comedy Hour episodes hosted by Abbott & Costello or Martin & Lewis; the complete Abbott and Costello Show in the weeknight slot. Excluded: colorized versions, foreign dubs, clip compilations and tributes, A Day at the Races (blackface number), Uncivil Warriors and later wartime Stooges shorts with racial caricature, the final Martin & Lewis Colgate show (yellowface parody), solo vehicles (Rock-a-Bye Baby, Copacabana) and the 142-minute Atoll K/Utopia print.
